_meta.purpose: Inputs of the 10-year district model (explorer/district.py): who looks for space around Marievik, what they value, what they pay, and what AMF's strategies cost. Read with data/projects/marievik/leases.json (who is in today) and data/studio/costs.json (running costs, energy).
_meta.status: EXAMPLE DATA: working values for discussion, not market research. Replace with AMF's rent roll, letting history and market reports (e.g. vacancy and rent statistics for Stockholm south / Liljeholmen) when available; keep the same shape.
_meta.units: rents and costs in SEK per m2 lettable and year (capex SEK per m2 once); carbon in kg CO2e per m2; demand as new tenants looking per year in the submarket that Marievik competes in

station.name: Liljeholmen (tunnelbana, Tvärbanan, buses)
station.note: approximate: where the light rail and railway meet in the urban context, in the site's local frame (SWEREF 99 TM minus origin)

attributes.life: active ground floors (food, retail, gym, cowork, culture) within 150 m, saturating at 8
attributes.green: public green and plaza m2 within 150 m, saturating at 12 000
attributes.quality: fit-out and building standard, 0-1 (retrofit and flexible fit-outs raise it)
attributes.flex: 1 when the space has demountable partitions
attributes.evening: evening activity within 150 m (food, gym, homes), saturating

activate_ground.label: Open the ground floors
activate_ground.text: Office and back-office ground floors become cafés, shops and a gym as they fall vacant; lettable area moves to the street.

flexible_fitout.label: Demountable fit-outs
flexible_fitout.text: Every new letting gets demountable partitions: cheaper, lower-carbon fit-outs, re-let a quarter sooner, office floors can switch to cowork or school without a full conversion.

convert_vacant.label: Convert long-vacant offices
convert_vacant.text: Office units vacant for a year are converted to the use with most unmet demand (homes, hotel, school).

public_realm.label: Plaza, quay and green
public_realm.text: Invest in the public realm between the buildings: more green and plaza within reach of every building, more life on the ground.

energy_retrofit.label: Energy retrofit
energy_retrofit.text: Retrofit envelopes and systems building by building (one per year): energy down 35 %, quality up.

rent_flex.label: Flexible rents
rent_flex.text: Asking rent 12 % lower on units vacant two quarters or more; short leases allowed.

shared_amenities.label: Shared amenities hub
shared_amenities.text: One unit in B01 becomes a shared meeting, event and fitness hub for every office tenant in the district: lettable area lost, quality up for all offices.
